limitations: This is a historical, self-selected review sample, not a representative customer survey. Classifications are incomplete or potentially mixed: the broad “other” group combines unspecified complaints, and some examples are flagged for human review. The saved contract is not officially validated; examples are illustrative rather than representative. Cancellation wording indicates intent, not observed churn. These aggregates cannot establish causal effects, population prevalence, revenue impact, or retention gains. A human should inspect the final argument and quote support.
recommendation: Prioritize usability, interface, and free-tier limitations. It has the highest saved priority score and a substantial complaint count; examples point to shuffle and ad frustrations as well as an unwanted home-screen experience ({{claim:issue-usability:complaint_count}}, {{claim:issue-usability:severity_sum}}, {{claim:issue-usability:priority_score}}; a78d831a-69f4-428a-9235-cfdd9775c509, 94c9f2f9-36fa-4c11-936e-660514fe7a35). Treat this as a directional product signal, not proof of prevalence or an expected retention outcome.
